title: Layout
description: The layout module displays the layout of the active workspace on the bar's output.

placeholders.description: The active workspace's layout: scrolling, dwindle, master, or stacking.

format.label: What to show
format.doc: The default format, how the layout should be displayed. The positional {} (the default) and {layout} are both replaced by the current layout name.
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables the module to consume all leftover space.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.

patterns.label: Format <layout>
patterns.description: The custom format to use when a specific layout is active (for example, format-scrolling, format-dwindle, format-master, or format-stacking). Keys use Umbriel's lowercase layout names and are case-sensitive. If no match is found, it falls back to format.
